title: Testing Something: Who here has launched a game that another human has played
author: broker415
selftext:
Doesn’t need to be launched of steam, commercially successful, or even live/hosted anywhere 

How many people have made something and then had another person other than themselves play and enjoy it.

Also great chance to shamelessly self promote if you have 😉

Where I’m coming from:   
I love tinkerers, I am one. I love building for the sake of building, experimenting, all great stuff 

The problem….

Most advice in the game dev space seems to center around commercial viability, public sentiment etc 

But a lot of the builders here are just having fun playing around with new tech…

Seems like a disconnect, so as a general sentiment/vibe check I’d love to know who has been building to build and who is building to launch their game to the public? 

Personally I haven’t decided which camp I’m in, so would love to hear from you

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
If you like experimenting/tinkering/fucking around I recommend game jams it's kinda both, public but without pressure :) there's often AI jams posted about here or you can find them around on itch and other places. Good way to mess about and get eyeballs on your game. I've done a few AI-powered ones and enjoyed. 

I feel you on "game dev space seems to center around commercial viability, public sentiment etc" it's fortuntely not a huge pressure in aigame dev spaces because it's not a huge expectation of it.

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: Yeah I feel like the advice I get on this Reddit is much more actionable and legit, other parts of the community feel too entrenched in sunk cost fallacy to be welcoming to change/outsiders

comments.author: xRizDev
comments.body:
Launched my first project just 1 month ago with zero marketing, and it’s already nearing 200 downloads at 5 stars.
What completely blows my mind as a solo dev is seeing over 40 players clock 20+ hours, and people even buying the optional support IAP.

Honestly, for a first project I’m more than thrilled. Android is a pretty brutal market though not sure if it's tougher than Steam or just a different beast entirely. Anyone have thoughts on that?

Here’s the link if anyone wants to check it out:

[PlayStore](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.herobuilder.agenciadehroes)
